grader.scenario: Fibre ONT optical power levels marginal (-28 dBm) causing intermittent frame drops
grader.notes: Outstanding technical performance featuring acknowledgment-then-refusal where the agent validated customer frustration, upheld diagnostic escalation protocol against unreasonable demands for immediate civils works, and resolved the fault via OLT laser re-calibration.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net gigabit optical network operations' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Jasper warmly throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated acknowledgment-then-refusal at [03:15] ('I completely understand how deeply frustrating and disruptive it is... However, because our engineering fault protocols require executing remote laser re-calibration and patch-lead verification before dispatching external civils teams, our service terms do not permit immediate physical drop cable replacement...').

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent restated the marginal optical power and frame drop issue accurately at [01:25].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent confirmed primary contact phone number accurately without repeating questions.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent executed laser power calibration from OLT, improved optical budget by 4 dB, and scheduled overnight monitoring.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, highly competent, and reassuring technical tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked relevant questions regarding optical diagnostic figures and error symptoms.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed optical power reached -24.6 dBm, alarm light turned green, and 500-packet ping test had zero loss.
